measurement_scope: USB input of Pico2W plus attached Waveshare Pico-ePaper-2.9 B/W V2; Wi-Fi deinitialized and WL_REG_ON=0, panel in sleep with RST=0; core clock150MHz before entry.

sampling.limitation: Coverage uses host packet receipt, not exact device sampling times. Four samples are ordered in each frame. Receipt continuity and CRC do not prove absence of device-side losses.

limitations: Results are USB assembly input, not RP2350 core current.
No independent calibration or no-load zero reference.
Sub10ms peaks may be missed at nominal100Hz.
Repeat range is reproducibility, not total measurement uncertainty.
Vendor documentation does not establish galvanic isolation or meter self-consumption exclusion.

within_window_change.interpretation: Descriptive change between first/last5seconds of central35secondwindow; no steady-state assumption.
